title: Fail-closed exclusion of heterogeneous hydraulic profiles
problem: The production-shaped adaptive provider currently owns one immutable hydraulic representation per bound provider and keys/builds it from node 1. Legacy SWAP hydraulics are node-indexed and allow hydraulic coefficients to differ between nodes. Applying the node-1 representation to a layered profile would be scientifically invalid.

minimal_admission_repair.provider_bind: reject when initialized 42-coefficient hydraulic authority differs between nodes
minimal_admission_repair.FMR_admission: reject adaptive opt-in when raw 24-row hydraulic input differs between nodes

future_extension: Layered/multi-authority adaptive hydraulics requires a separately qualified provider that selects a representation per unique node/material authority. It is not admitted by F-AHL42.
prospective_checks: direct adaptive provider rejects a two-authority profile before cache acquisition
serialized FMR rejects heterogeneous adaptive mode 5 before solver execution
rejected heterogeneous paths do not change adaptive cache statistics
default-off and qbot analytical fallbacks remain green
